is_anopheles.evidence: Mentions Anopheles mosquitoes in relation to malaria transmission and ITN use (e.g. page 4: 'to combat Anopheles mosquitoes indoors').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions 'kdr resistance gene' generically in the text (page 8) referencing other literature, but does not assay or report any specific target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No mosquito genotype data, allele frequencies, or sample sizes are presented.

african_field_population.evidence: No mosquito populations were sampled or tested in this paper.

is_primary_study.evidence: The article is explicitly a review paper ('Review Article', page 1) focusing on human health effects of long-term exposure to insecticide-treated bednets.

sub_country_location.evidence: No primary mosquito sampling was conducted.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No primary mosquito collection was conducted.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Not applicable as this is a narrative review paper.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; this is a review paper.

assessment.summary: This is a review article discussing the potential toxicological and health hazards of long-term exposure to insecticide-treated mosquito nets in malaria-endemic regions. It does not contain any primary empirical data or insecticide resistance marker genotyping in Anopheles mosquitoes.
